THE IDEA IN BRIEF
Skyline's brand idea is "Reconnect", customers reconnect with nature and each other. The product idea behind it is called "SMART", expressed through six Pillars (Space & Liveability, Comfort & Everyday Use, Energy & Control, Construction & Materials, Touring Capability, Ownership Ease). You don't need to recite this to customers, just use it to know which Pillar a customer's question belongs to.
SMART PillarSelling directionCustomer value
🏠 Smart Space & LiveabilitySpace designed around real travelMore usable space, less daily friction
☕ Smart Comfort & Everyday UseA more considered interior and daily routineFeel comfortable wherever you stop
🔋 Smart Energy & ControlPower confidence and simpler controlStay longer, operate with clarity
🧱 Smart Construction & MaterialsMaterials and engineering chosen with purposeGreater confidence in how it's built
🧭 Smart Touring CapabilityTouring confidence beyond the highwayReach more places with confidence
🔑 Smart Ownership EaseSmall details that make ownership easierLess time managing small hassles
THE SALES CONVERSATION METHOD, use this every time

Need → Fact → Benefit → Value → Parameter Table → Demonstration → Next step

  • Discover: Ask an open question about travel party, road use, daily routine, energy expectations, tow vehicle and ownership priorities.
  • Select: Choose one relevant Pillar and one or two Facts. Do not unload the whole spec list.
  • Explain: Link the Fact to a concrete customer Benefit and the higher-order Value.
  • Confirm: Open the current Parameter Table for the exact model, floorplan and configuration.
  • Prove: Show, operate, measure or inspect the feature on the exact unit.
  • Advance: Ask for one clear next action, shortlist, viewing, quote, towing consultation or follow-up.
  • Record: Capture need, interest, objection, model/floorplan, configuration checked and next action in CRM.
"You mentioned [need]. This [Fact] matters because it helps [Benefit], supporting [Value]. Let me show you the feature and check the exact Skyline V1.51 configuration for this model."
NEVER SAY: "Skyline has everything." "This is the best." "It will last longer." "It can go anywhere." "This is definitely standard."
PARAMETER TABLE RULES, the most important habit

Every Fact is usable. Fitment can still vary.

All Facts in this handbook are confirmed and usable in conversation. But a confirmed Fact may still vary by version, model, floorplan, quantity or standard/optional fitment, always check the current Parameter Table and inspect the actual caravan.

  • Model, floorplan, quantity, dimension, rating, capacity, standard/optional fitment or availability question → check the Parameter Table.
  • Table silent on something? Do not guess from memory, an old brochure or another version.
  • Live unit differs from the table? Use the actual caravan as the reference and report the discrepancy.
  • Always record which model/floorplan/version was shown or quoted.
Safe response: "That can vary by model and configuration. I'll check the current Skyline V1.51 Parameter Table so I give you the exact answer."

Quick check-in, see how these ideas would sound out on the floor. No pressure, retry any time.

TWO FEATURED UPDATES, know these cold

SKY-F-024, Fans

Fact: Three onboard fans, digital displays, remote controls, fine protective grilles.

Fitment: some V1.51 units have them; others receive them from V1.61, always check the actual caravan.

DO NOT SAY "Childproof." Normal supervision still applies.

SKY-F-051, Touring configuration

Fact: 70 mm lift kit with 16-inch all-terrain tyres.

Millimetres only, "70 mm." Never imply unrestricted off-road capability.
OBJECTION-HANDLING GUARDRAILS
Customer saysSales response
"Is that standard?"Check the current Parameter Table for the selected model/floorplan.
"How long can it stay off-grid?"Ask about loads/charging, confirm capacities. Do not promise duration.
"Can it go off-road?"Explain the touring-use boundary. No unrestricted claims.
"Does it have the updated fans?"Inspect the actual caravan, some V1.51 units have them, others from V1.61.
"Is the fan childproof?"No product is childproof. Explain the finer grille as an added detail; supervision still applies.
"Is it better than Brand X?"Return to confirmed Skyline evidence. No competitor claims.
"Will my tow vehicle handle it?"Use exact model data + towing consultation. No suitability guarantee without vehicle/load info.
Four-part response: Acknowledge → Clarify the need → Show evidence and scope → Confirm the next step.

SELF-CHECK, before you're on the floor
  • Can I explain Reconnect/SMART briefly, without listing specifications?
  • Can I ask one discovery question per Pillar?
  • Do I know when the Parameter Table must be opened?
  • Can I explain fan fitment without calling it "childproof"?
  • Can I quote the touring lift kit in millimetres only and keep the touring boundary clear?
  • Can I respond safely to standard/optional, off-grid, off-road, competitor and tow-vehicle questions?
  • Can I finish every conversation with a clear next step and a usable CRM note?
SELL THE FIT: Ask first. Use only relevant Facts. Explain the Benefit. Check the Parameter Table. Demonstrate the exact unit. Agree the next step.

Final check-in, the reference material and CRM habits that keep every conversation on track.
